title: excel-inflow-support-coverage-grid/1.0
description: P7.1a — the JOIN between every value the support envelope CLAIMS (assets/support-envelope-v377.json) and the evidence that proves the product actually handles it. REPORT-MODE ONLY: this artifact narrows nothing, refuses nothing and is consumed by no run. It is compiled by scripts/lib/support_coverage_grid.mjs and verified by scripts/run_support_coverage_grid_tests.mjs. Two evidence tiers only: extraction_evidence (a real filing is required because the claim concerns reading messy source documents; such evidence lives in CUSTODY and is referenced by hash/id ONLY, never copied into the repository) and model_shape_evidence (a synthetic in-repo case suffices because the claim concerns economics, period arithmetic or a pre-extraction refusal decided from intake facts alone). This file constrains SHAPE only; tier totality, reference resolution, the anti-silence gate (every declared envelope value must appear as a row) and status/gap-reason consistency are enforced by the runner.

mode.description: The grid measures the gap. It never narrows the envelope, never changes classification and never makes a run refuse. The narrowing decision is the user's and is taken outside this artifact.

envelope_sha256.description: Digest of the support-envelope contract this grid was compiled against. A mismatch means the envelope moved and the grid must be regenerated — the grid may never lag the claims it joins.

manifest.description: Repository-relative manifest path. A leading slash (an absolute host path) is refused by the portability contract.

tier.description: mixed: the source contributes cases at both tiers; each case names its own tier.

grid_effect.description: Custody-root presence is a runtime probe, never a row-status input. The committed grid is byte-identical with and without a custody root; custody evidence is joined by hash/id from the in-repo register alone.

excluded_claim_kinds.description: Envelope claim kinds that are declared but are NOT joinable to a corpus case, listed so their exclusion from the rows is visible rather than silent.

custody_joins.description: Every mechanism by which the in-repo custody register is joined to an envelope value, with the justification for the join. Extraction-tier evidence is never joined by an undeclared rule.

curated_mappings.description: Every join that required human semantic judgement rather than a computed structural probe, listed so the user can audit assertion against computation. Each entry's referent must resolve and, where a token is cited, the compiler verifies the cited manifest field actually contains it.

verified_token.description: A substring the compiler asserts is present in the cited manifest field, upgrading the curation from assertion to verified assertion.

proven_by_real_filing.description: Rows carrying at least one extraction_evidence proving case (a real filing referenced by hash/id).

proven_by_synthetic_case.description: Rows carrying at least one model_shape_evidence proving case (an in-repo synthetic case).

unproven_by_gap_reason.description: Counts over rows with status unproven, keyed by primary gap reason.

gapped_rows_by_gap_reason.description: Counts over every row that is not proven (unproven plus partially_proven), keyed by primary gap reason.

extraction_tier_gaps_by_reason.description: Rows whose extraction tier is unmet, split into a filing-supply gap (no_real_filing_available) and a register classification-work gap (custody_register_lacks_dimension_axis).

model_shape_tier_gaps.description: Rows whose model-shape tier is unmet: values closable by authoring a synthetic case, with no new filing required.

dimensions_without_custody_axis.description: Envelope dimensions the in-repo custody register cannot classify at all. No real filing can be joined to any value of these dimensions until the register gains an axis for them.

case_id.description: A repo-fixture case_id, a blocker-corpus case_id, or a custody candidate id (16 lowercase hex). Never a path, URL or issuer name — custody evidence is referenced by hash/id only.

probe_kind.description: structural: computed from the case/document's own fields. attested_category / attested_qualification: the custody register itself attests the fact (HASH_BOUND_VERIFIED category, or a qualification boolean on a candidate). curated_manifest_field: a declared human semantic mapping over an attested manifest field, listed in curated_mappings.

attestation.description: The attested custody category or qualification field backing this proving case, when the probe kind is an attested one.

dimension.description: An envelope dimension name, or debt_instruments.declared_matrix for the ten declared instrument classes.

declared_class.description: The support class the envelope assigns this value. DECLARED_MATRIX_MEMBER marks the ten instrument classes, which the envelope declares as the content of debt_instruments.within_declared_matrix rather than as a classified dimension value.

gap_reasons_by_tier.description: Tier-specific gap types, never collapsed into the headline reason. The extraction type distinguishes a filing-supply gap (the register has the axis, no candidate covers the value) from a classification-work gap (the register has no axis for this dimension at all).

adjacent_non_case_evidence.description: Evidence that exists but is NOT a corpus case and therefore never counts as proof — typically a classifier unit assertion. Recorded so the gap is exact rather than overstated; it never changes status.
